claims: The Deontay Wilder vs. Dereck Chisora heavyweight boxing match takes place on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
The Deontay Wilder vs. Dereck Chisora heavyweight boxing match takes place at the O2 Arena in London, UK.
The DAZN pay-per-view main card begins at 2 p.m. ET (7 p.m. BST).
The main event ring walks are scheduled for approximately 5:26 p.m. ET (10:26 p.m. BST).
Ring walk times depend on the duration of the undercard bouts.
